newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Papers report record S.Korea foreign investment.
newsitem.headline: Papers report record S.Korea foreign investment.

text.p: The South Korean finance ministry on Wednesday said direct foreign investment in the nation for the first half of the year hit a record high at $4.46 billion, according to newspaper reports.
They said it was a 252 percent increase compared to the same period last year when foreign investment was $1.27 billion.
The semi-annual level of foreign investments this year already surpassed last year's total foreign investments of $3.2 billion, the papers said.
Finance ministry officials were not available for comment.

The papers said foreign investment in the non-manufacturing sector rose 800 percent to $3.35 billion during the first half of the year, centering around hotels and discount stores, while investment in manufacturing rose 24.9 percent to $1.11 billion.
